macros.name: mspart
macros.doc: \mspart is a new sectioning command, designed to format the header at the beginning of each APA manuscript ‘part’ — e.g., the abstract, the main body, the references, etc. The syntax is exactly the same as for \section and friends, e.g.: \mspart{Abstract}.
